Apple AirTag — Pack of One — Second Generation

The Apple AirTag is the simplest and most effective item tracker ever made. Attach it to your keys, slip it into your bag, tuck it in your luggage or loop it onto your bicycle and you will never truly lose that item again. Since the launch of AirTag in 2021, users from around the world have shared stories of being reunited with lost luggage, keys, bicycles, bags and more. With the help of an AirTag placed inside an instrument case, a musician was able to locate their lost instrument and perform that evening, while another user was able to find lost luggage that contained a lifesaving medication.

The second-generation AirTag is powered by Apple's second-generation Ultra Wideband chip — the same chip found in the iPhone 17 lineup. Using haptic, visual and audio feedback, Precision Finding guides users to their lost items from up to 50 percent farther away than the previous generation, and an upgraded Bluetooth chip expands the range at which items can be located. This is the latest and most capable AirTag Apple has ever made, available at the same price as its predecessor.

Why AirTag Is the Best Item Tracker for Pakistan

Pakistan is one of the most relevant markets in the world for a product like AirTag. Luggage going missing at Karachi's Jinnah International, Lahore's Allama Iqbal or Islamabad's New Islamabad International Airport is a genuine and common frustration for Pakistani travellers. Keys, wallets and bags going missing in busy commercial areas, offices and crowded markets are everyday experiences. Motorcycles and bicycles being taken from outside homes and shops are a persistent concern across every major Pakistani city.

AirTag addresses all of these scenarios with technology that works entirely within the iPhone you already own, at no subscription cost and with no monthly fee. The only requirement is an iPhone and an Apple ID — both of which every iPhone owner in Pakistan already has.

How AirTag Works — No GPS Required

Your AirTag sends out a secure Bluetooth signal that can be detected by nearby devices in the Find My network. These devices send the location of your AirTag to iCloud — then you can go to the Find My app and see it on a map. The whole process is anonymous and encrypted to protect your privacy. And it is efficient, so there is no need to worry about battery life or data usage.

The Find My network is the most powerful crowdsourced tracking network in the world. AirTags use Apple's crowdsourced Find My network, estimated to consist of approximately one billion devices worldwide that detect and anonymously report emitted Bluetooth signals. In Pakistan's major cities — Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi and Faisalabad — the density of iPhones in circulation means the Find My network has strong coverage throughout urban and suburban areas. When your AirTag is out of your own Bluetooth range, every nearby iPhone, iPad and Mac that passes close to it silently and anonymously reports its location to iCloud. You see the location update on your map without any other user knowing they helped find it.

Precision Finding — Guided to Within Centimetres

If your AirTag is nearby, your iPhone or Apple Watch can lead you straight to it. Thanks to its expanded Precision Finding range and built-in Ultra Wideband technology, you will see the exact distance and direction to head in — whether you left it on the counter or in the car. Precision Finding uses the U2 Ultra Wideband chip to measure your AirTag's precise location in three-dimensional space relative to your iPhone. An arrow on screen points you in the exact direction to walk, with a distance readout that counts down as you approach. Haptic feedback increases as you get closer. The built-in speaker plays a chime to help you locate it for the final few feet. The result is finding your keys hiding under a couch cushion or your bag at the back of an office storage room in seconds rather than minutes.

Precision Finding on Apple Watch

For the first time, users can use Precision Finding on Apple Watch Series 9 or later, or Apple Watch Ultra 2 or later, to find their AirTag, bringing a powerful experience to the wrist. Precision Finding guides users through haptic, visual and audio feedback to their lost items from up to 50 percent farther away than the previous generation. With your iPhone in your bag or pocket, your Apple Watch can guide you to an AirTag through wrist haptics and the watch face display — without needing to hold your phone out in front of you.

50 Percent Louder Speaker

The new AirTag is 50 percent louder than the previous generation, enabling users to hear their AirTag from up to 2x farther than before. With a 50 percent louder speaker, you can now hear AirTag from up to twice as far away. For AirTags attached to keys buried in a large bag, slipped inside luggage or sitting in a kitchen drawer, the louder speaker makes the difference between hearing it immediately and having to search through everything manually. The new distinctive chime is also easier to distinguish from other household sounds than the previous generation's alert.

Lost Mode — Crowd-Powered Recovery

Just like your other Apple devices, AirTag can be put into Lost Mode. Then, when it is detected by a device in the network, you will automatically get a notification. You can also set it so someone can get your contact info by tapping your AirTag with their NFC-capable smartphone — that is the same technology that lets people pay for things with their phones. When you mark an AirTag as lost and enable Lost Mode, you receive a notification the moment any device in the Find My network detects it. If a good Samaritan in Pakistan finds your lost bag with an AirTag inside, tapping any NFC-capable phone to the AirTag immediately shows your contact number. No app download required from their side — just a tap and your details appear.

Share Item Location With Airlines — 90 Percent Fewer Lost Bags

AirTag integrates seamlessly with Share Item Location, an iOS feature designed to help users recover a misplaced item by temporarily and securely sharing its location with trusted third parties, such as airlines. Apple has partnered directly with more than 50 airlines to privately and securely accept Share Item Location links. According to SITA, a leading IT provider for airlines, carriers report that using Share Item Location has reduced baggage delays by 26 percent and reduced incidences of truly lost or unrecoverable luggage by 90 percent. For Pakistani travellers flying Pakistan International Airlines, Turkish Airlines, Emirates, Etihad, Qatar Airways or any of the 50 plus partner airlines, a lost luggage claim can now be accompanied by a live share of your bag's location. The airline's customer service team sees exactly where your bag is — and 90 percent of bags that would previously have been permanently lost are now recovered.

Built-in Privacy and Anti-Stalking Protection

Only you can see where your AirTag is. Your location data and history are never stored on the AirTag itself. Devices that relay the location of your AirTag also stay anonymous, and that location data is encrypted every step of the way. So not even Apple knows the location of your AirTag or the identity of the device that helps find it.

AirTag is designed to discourage unwanted tracking. If someone else's AirTag finds its way into your stuff, your iPhone or Android phone will notice it is travelling with you and send you an alert. If you still have not found it after a while, the AirTag will start playing a sound letting you know it is there. In 2024, Apple and Google launched true cross-platform detection support — Android devices can now also detect unknown AirTags, making the anti-stalking protection universal regardless of phone type.

IP67 Water and Dust Resistance

The water resistance of an AirTag is rated IP67. An AirTag can withstand 30 minutes of water immersion in standard laboratory conditions. IP67 covers rain, splashing, accidental drops in water and everyday exposure to Pakistani monsoon conditions. An AirTag on your keys survives getting wet along with everything else in your pocket. An AirTag in your bag handles unexpected rain without any concern.

One Year Battery Life, User Replaceable

The AirTag runs on a standard CR2032 coin cell battery with approximately one year of life under normal use. When the battery is low, your iPhone notifies you automatically so you never lose track functionality unexpectedly. Replacing the battery takes seconds — press and twist the polished steel back, swap the CR2032 battery and close. CR2032 batteries are available from every pharmacy, hardware store and supermarket in Pakistan for a few rupees.

Free Personalised Engraving

When purchasing AirTag from apple.com or the Apple Store app, free personalised engraving is available including text and a selection of emoji. Engraving helps identify individual AirTags in a household where multiple are in use and adds a personal touch to what is otherwise a functional accessory. Engraved AirTags make practical and personalised gifts for family members, particularly parents, children away from home or anyone who regularly misplaces essential items.

Family Sharing — Track Together

Share AirTag with up to five people. So items that everyone uses — like an umbrella, a bike or the family car keys — can be tracked by friends and family. With Family Sharing enabled, a single AirTag attached to the family car, the house keys or a shared bicycle is visible to every member of the family group. Any family member can use Find My to check where those shared items are without needing their own separate AirTag.

AirTag Accessories — Wear It Your Way

AirTag is a small disc that needs to be attached to something to be useful. Apple and third-party manufacturers make a wide range of holders, loops and cases designed to attach AirTag to practically anything. Keyring holders, luggage tags, bag clips, bicycle mounts, wallet holders and pet collar attachments are all widely available. The AirTag itself has no built-in loop or attachment point — you need an accessory to attach it to most items. These are available from Vision Tech and from other accessories retailers across Pakistan.

Frequently Asked Questions

How does Apple AirTag work without GPS?

AirTags do not have GPS hardware, but they can still provide precise location tracking with the Find My network. Instead of calculating a location using a satellite network, AirTags emit a secure Bluetooth signal that nearby devices in the Find My network can detect. These devices then relay the AirTag's location to iCloud. You can then track it through the Find My app and view its position on a map. The entire process is designed with privacy in mind, ensuring that location data remains anonymous and encrypted.

What is new in the second-generation AirTag?

The second-generation AirTag is powered by Apple's second-generation Ultra Wideband chip, the same chip found in the iPhone 17 lineup. Precision Finding guides users to their lost items from up to 50 percent farther away than the previous generation, an upgraded Bluetooth chip expands the range at which items can be located, and the new AirTag is 50 percent louder than the previous generation, enabling users to hear it from up to 2x farther than before. Precision Finding on Apple Watch Series 9 and later is also new to this generation.

Can I use AirTag to track my luggage on flights from Pakistan?

Yes. Apple has partnered directly with more than 50 airlines to privately and securely accept Share Item Location links. According to SITA, carriers report that using Share Item Location has reduced baggage delays by 26 percent and reduced incidences of truly lost or unrecoverable luggage by 90 percent. If your bag goes missing, you can share a temporary live location link from the Find My app directly with the airline's customer service team. They can see exactly where your bag is without accessing any other personal data. Many Pakistani travellers now place an AirTag in every checked bag before flying.

Does AirTag work in Pakistan?

Yes. AirTag works anywhere in the world where there are Apple devices — which means any location where iPhones are present. In Pakistan's major cities including Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi and Faisalabad, the density of iPhone users means the Find My network has strong urban coverage. In more rural areas, coverage depends on iPhone density nearby. When your AirTag is within direct Bluetooth range of your iPhone, it works regardless of location without needing any other device. When outside Bluetooth range, the Find My network relays its location whenever a nearby iPhone comes close.

Does AirTag require a monthly subscription?

No. AirTag has no subscription fee and no monthly cost. You buy it once and it works through the Find My network indefinitely. The only ongoing cost is the CR2032 battery replacement approximately once per year, which costs a few rupees from any pharmacy or general store in Pakistan. No iCloud storage subscription is required for AirTag to function, though having an Apple ID is required for setup.

Can Android phones detect AirTags?

Yes for detection of unwanted tracking, but not for the full AirTag experience. In 2024, Apple and Google launched true cross-platform support. Android devices can detect unknown Apple AirTags and iPhones can detect trackers made for Android's Find My Device network. If an AirTag that is not yours is travelling with you, any Android phone will alert you. However, to use an AirTag as your own item tracker — setting it up, naming it, using Precision Finding and viewing it in Find My — you need an iPhone.

Can I share an AirTag with my family?

Yes. Share AirTag with up to five people. So items that everyone uses — like an umbrella, a bike or the family car keys — can be tracked by friends and family. Through Apple's Family Sharing feature, up to five family members can see the location of a shared AirTag in their own Find My app. This is useful for tracking family vehicles, house keys, shared bags or any item multiple family members might need to locate.

What accessories do I need to attach an AirTag to my keys or bag?

The AirTag itself has no built-in keyring hole or attachment point. To attach it to keys, bags, luggage or other items, you need a compatible holder. Apple makes official AirTag accessories including keyring loops and luggage tags. Many third-party options are also available in Pakistan from accessories retailers — silicone sleeves with key rings, leather keyring holders, credit-card-style wallet holders and clip-on luggage tag holders are all common. Vision Tech stocks AirTag accessories alongside the AirTag itself.

How long does the AirTag battery last and how do I replace it?

The CR2032 coin cell battery lasts approximately one year under normal use. When it is running low, your iPhone sends a notification through the Find My app. To replace it, press down on the polished stainless steel back of the AirTag and rotate anticlockwise to open. Remove the old CR2032 battery, insert a new one positive side up, and rotate the cover clockwise to close. CR2032 batteries are available from pharmacies, electronics shops and general stores across Pakistan for a few rupees.

Does Vision Tech deliver AirTag outside Karachi?

Yes. Nationwide delivery covers Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Hyderabad and all major cities. Cash on Delivery is available for most locations. Contact Vision Tech directly for current stock availability and pricing before ordering.

Leave it at the office, in the car or at a friend's house and you see exactly where it is without calling anyone. If a bag is taken without your knowledge in a crowded market or public transport, Lost Mode activates instantly and every iPhone that passes near it updates your map. The bag nearly never gets permanently lost when the airline can see exactly where it is.

Wallet — Your Most Critical Item, Always Found

An AirTag in the wallet means you know immediately if it is not with you and exactly where it is. If it has been left somewhere, you see the location on the map.
